verdicts.reason: I couldn't separate these two; they are nearly pixel-identical and share the same flaws. In both, the thin white frame floats on its own over the racket instead of enclosing the design, the blue panel runs off the bottom edge with a notched top and a large empty lower half, and the divider rules have slipped under 'submitting' and 'Program' so they look like stray underlines. Also, 'by submitting to' and 'Xavier Sport Program' are crammed onto one line, and the photo is badly upscaled and blurry. The only visible difference is the frame's position (about 10 px higher in B, with a faint extra line near the top), which doesn't change the result.
